layer.elemental_bendings.bending.missing: You have not chosen whether you can bend.
layer.elemental_bendings.bending.name: Bending
origin.elemental_bendings.airbender.desc: You bend the air around you. Slice with blades of wind, blast enemies away, leap again and again through the sky and ride a spinning ball of air over land and water.
origin.elemental_bendings.airbender.name: Airbender
origin.elemental_bendings.earthbender.de: You bend earth and stone. Kick boulders out of the ground, lift and hurl them, raise pillars and walls, tunnel through hills and ride a column into the sky. Stand your ground.
origin.elemental_bendings.firebender.des: You bend fire drawn from your own breath. Punch flame, sweep walls of fire across the ground, breathe fire, and rocket into the air on a jet of flame. Rain and water douse you.
origin.elemental_bendings.non_bender.des: Most people in the world cannot bend. You rely on your wits, your weapons and whatever your other origin gives you.
origin.elemental_bendings.waterbender.de: You bend water in all its forms: pull it from rivers, rain or a bucket, lash it like a whip, raise a shield around yourself, freeze it into spears and shards, and ride it across the sea. Push, pull and flow. Master it and you can learn bloodbending or plantbending in the Waterbending Paths skill tree.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/air_b: %3$s, %1$s, then hold %2$s: spin up a ball of air, sit on it and ride it wherever you look. It climbs over blocks and skims across water for as long as you hold %2$s. Let go or hop off and it breaks apart.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/air_j: %1$s, %3$s in mid-air: push off the air itself to leap again, up to four times before you land. While gliding with an elytra it throws you forward instead.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/air_k: %2$s, %1$s, %2$s: kick a powerful gust that throws back everything in front of you and strips the leaves off trees.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/air_n: You move with the wind. Your gusts put out fires they pass through, and a landing after an Air Jump is always cushioned.
power.elemental_bendings.airbender/air_s: %1$s, %2$s, %2$s: cut the air with a blade of wind that slices through everything in its path.
power.elemental_bendings.earthbender/ear: %2$s, %3$s, then hold %3$s while standing on earth: a column rises under your feet and carries you up for as long as you hold %3$s.

%2$s, %1$s, %3$s while looking at earth up to six blocks away: rip the block out and kick it at your enemies. It flies level and curves into whoever is in front of you. Do it while sneaking to launch yourself off the ground instead.

%3$s, %2$s, %3$s while looking at earth: lift the block and hold it in front of you for up to twelve seconds. It follows your aim, so line it up and press %1$s to throw it where you look, or %2$s to let it fall.

%1$s, %3$s, %2$s while looking at earth up to twelve blocks away: thrust a pillar out of it. Aimed at the ground or a one block step, it rises three blocks. Aimed at a wall, it shoots two blocks out of the side you can see, and aimed at a ceiling it hangs down. Anything in its way takes a hit and is carried to the tip of the pillar and thrown off the end, upward from the ground and away from the wall. Aim at your own feet to ride a pillar up.

%1$s, %2$s, %3$s, then hold %2$s: wherever you look at the ground, at least two blocks away and up to seven, a wall of earth three blocks high rises. Sweep your view across the ground to build a wall.
%1$s, %2$s, %3$s, then hold %3$s: part the earth in front of you and tunnel through it for as long as you hold %3$s. Only natural earth gives way, ores stay where they are, and nothing drops.
%3$s, %2$s, %2$s, %1$s: send a wave of earth rolling along the ground that crashes through everything in front of you.
power.elemental_bendings.earthbender/neu: You bend natural earth and stone: dirt, sand, gravel, clay, stone, deepslate, terracotta, the stones of the Nether and the End, and the ores inside them, even under a layer of snow. Earth you tear up or raise settles back into place after thirty seconds, and kicks, waves and columns need solid footing.
power.elemental_bendings.firebender/fire: %1$s, %2$s, %3$s, then hold %1$s: breathe a stream of fire for as long as you hold it, up to about seven seconds.
%2$s, %1$s, %1$s: spin and throw a ring of flame out around you.

%2$s, %3$s in mid-air: blast yourself upward, once before you land. Keep holding %3$s and a jet of fire takes over, so you hover for as long as you hold it. After the jump, %2$s and a held %3$s starts the jet again. Hold jump to rise and sneak to sink. With an elytra the jet drives you forward instead, and landing after a Fire Jump never hurts.
%1$s, %2$s, %1$s: punch a short burst of flame that sets whatever it touches alight.
%3$s, %2$s, %1$s: sweep a line of fire along the ground in front of you.
power.elemental_bendings.firebender/inne: Your fire comes from your breath and the sun. Rain, water and bubble columns douse every fire move, and your fire burns a quarter hotter while the sun is up.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/blo: %2$s while holding blood: hurl it as a heavy ball that bursts on whatever it hits.
%3$s while holding blood: clot it into a dark, hard mass. %3$s again thins it back into blood.
%2$s while holding clotted blood: rake it apart into a spray of hard shards.
%1$s while holding clotted blood: throw it as a piercing spear that leaves its victims withering.
%2$s, %3$s, %1$s: tear blood out of every living creature within six blocks, wounding each a little, and hold it as a ball.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/fre: %3$s while holding water: freeze it into ice. %3$s again thaws it back into water.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/ice: %2$s while holding ice: shatter it into a spray of shards.
%1$s while holding ice: throw a piercing spear of ice that freezes and slows what it hits.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/pic: %2$s, %3$s, %1$s: draw water up and hold it for fifteen seconds. Hold a potion bottle in your main hand and keep %1$s held to bend healing water instead, which mends you and whoever you point it at.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/pla: %3$s while holding sap: press it down into thick mud. %3$s again thins it back into sap.
%2$s while holding sap: drive it into a storm of razor leaves that slice through everything in front of you.
%1$s while holding mud: heave it in a heavy arc. It hits much harder than water, slows and blinds.
%2$s while holding mud: fling it in a wide spray that slows and blinds whatever it hits.
%2$s, %3$s, %1$s: pull the water out of every plant within four blocks. Leaves fall, flowers and grass vanish and the ground turns to dirt for thirty seconds, and you hold the water as sap.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/pus: You bend water you can reach: water, ice, snow or rain within five blocks, a water bucket (three uses before it runs dry) or a potion bottle. Your waterbending is a quarter stronger at night and twice as strong under a full moon. Defeating creatures earns mastery points for the Waterbending Paths skill tree, where you can learn bloodbending or plantbending.
power.elemental_bendings.waterbender/wat: %2$s while holding water: hurl it forward in a crashing jet that knocks back and puts out fire.
%1$s, %2$s, then hold %3$s while in water: ride a rushing wave across the surface wherever you look.
%1$s, then hold %3$s while holding water: wrap yourself in a bubble of water that stops arrows and fire. You can barely move inside it.
%1$s, then hold %2$s while holding water: coil the water around you. Tap %1$s to lash out with it. Let go of %2$s to gather the water back up.
skill.elemental_bendings.waterbender.blo: %2$s, %1$s, then hold %3$s at night: take hold of the creature you look at and work it like a puppet. It hangs in front of you and follows your aim while you hold %3$s, and cannot strike back. Tap %1$s to make it lash out at everything around it, or %2$s to hurl it away. This replaces Water Glide, because a bloodbender cannot ride the waves.
While holding blood, %1$s, then hold %2$s: coil the blood into a whip. Tap %1$s to lash out. Every creature the lash cuts gives you back some health. Let go of %2$s to gather the blood back up.

Bend the blood inside living creatures. Your waterbending turns to bloodbending at night, and the full moon doubles its strength. Undead and constructs have no blood to bend.

%2$s, %3$s, %1$s: Draw Blood from every creature within six blocks.
While holding blood, %2$s: Blood Blast. %3$s: Clot it, and %3$s again to thin it.
While holding clotted blood, %1$s: Clot Spear. %2$s: Clot Shards.

While holding blood, %1$s, then hold %3$s: seize the blood of every creature in front of you and lift them off the ground. They hang helpless in the air until you let go of %3$s or the blood runs out, then drop.
You no longer need the moon. Bloodbending answers you at any hour, so your waterbending is gone for good, and the full moon still doubles your strength.
While holding blood, %1$s, %1$s: pour it into the creature you look at and heal it. Sneak while you do it to drink the blood and heal yourself instead.
skill.elemental_bendings.waterbender.pla:
Bend the water inside living plants. Plantbending replaces your waterbending, so you draw sap from leaves and grass instead of water from rivers.

%2$s, %3$s, %1$s near plants: Wither them and hold their sap.
While holding sap, %2$s: Leaf Storm. %3$s: Condense it into mud, and %3$s again to thin it.
While holding mud, %1$s: Mud Shot. %2$s: Mud Splatter.

%2$s, %3$s, %3$s, %1$s near plants: pull the plants around you into a towering golem and fight from inside it for thirty seconds. The golem is huge, heavily armored and punches very hard, but it is slow. %1$s slams the ground around you. Do the combo again to step out early.
%3$s, %2$s, %1$s while looking at open ground: hide a coil of vines there. The first creature to step on it is bound for a few seconds. You can keep three snares set at once, and each lasts a minute.

%2$s, %1$s, %3$s: burst the pollen out of every flower and the spores out of every mushroom within ten blocks. Creatures standing near them are dazed: sick, slow, half blind and weak. This replaces Water Glide.
While holding sap, %1$s, then hold %3$s: vines burst from the ground in front of you and bind every creature they catch. They cannot move or jump and the thorns cut them for as long as you hold %3$s.

While holding sap, %1$s, then hold %2$s: grow the sap into a thorned vine coiled around you. Tap %1$s to lash out. The lash drags what it hits toward you and slows it. Let go of %2$s to draw the sap back.
skill_tree.elemental_bendings.waterbende: Every 4 creatures you defeat earn a mastery point. Spend them on bloodbending or plantbending, which trade your waterbending for the path one move at a time.
text.elemental_bendings.bucket_empty: Your water bucket has run dry
text.elemental_bendings.mastery_point: Your bending grows: +1 mastery point. Press %s to spend it.
text.elemental_bendings.no_blood: There is no living blood close enough to bend
text.elemental_bendings.no_earth: There is no earth in reach to bend
text.elemental_bendings.no_patient: Look at a living creature to give it your blood, or sneak to drink it
text.elemental_bendings.no_plants: There are no plants close enough to bend
text.elemental_bendings.no_puppet: There is no one in reach to bloodbend
text.elemental_bendings.no_snare_spot: Look at open ground to set a snare
text.elemental_bendings.no_spores: There are no flowers or mushrooms close enough
text.elemental_bendings.no_water: There is no water close enough to bend
text.elemental_bendings.traps_set: You already have three snares set
